examples: She frowned at the mess.
Do not frown.
He frowned.

more.def: To pull your eyebrows together and turn the corners of your mouth down to show that you are sad or not pleased.
examples: She frowned at the mess on the floor.
Do not frown, because the day is nice.
He frowned when he read the hard question.

easy.def: A sad or cross look on your face.
examples: She had a frown.
Her frown was small.
His frown went away.

more.def: An unhappy or angry look on the face, with eyebrows pulled together.
examples: She had a frown on her face.
A frown is the opposite of a smile.
His frown turned into a grin.
The pond is frozen.
The frozen peas are cold.
The ground was frozen.

more.def: Hard like ice because of cold, or kept very cold.
examples: The pond is frozen solid.
I ate a frozen yogurt.
The frozen ground was hard to dig.

easy.def: A sweet food that grows on trees or plants, like an apple.
examples: I eat fruit for a snack.
An apple is a fruit.
The fruit is ripe.

more.def: The sweet part of a plant that holds seeds, such as an apple or a berry.
examples: Apples, bananas and peaches are all fruit.
Birds eat the fruit from the tree.
She put fresh fruit in her cereal.

related.def: Without any fruit; of no use.

easy.def: A heavy cake with bits of fruit and nuts.
examples: Grandma made a fruitcake.
The fruitcake is sweet.
We ate fruitcake at Christmas.

more.def: A heavy, sweet cake filled with dried fruit and nuts, often eaten at Christmas.
examples: Grandma baked a fruitcake full of cherries and raisins for the holidays.
The fruitcake was dense and spicy.
We cut the fruitcake into thin slices.
The talk was fruitful.
I saw a fruitful tree.
The fruitful day was good.

more.def: Producing good results or lots of fruit.
examples: The meeting was fruitful, and we made a plan.
A fruitful tree gave us many apples.
Their hard work was fruitful.
The drink is fruity.
I like fruity candy.
The soap smells fruity.

more.def: Tasting or smelling like fruit.
examples: The soap had a sweet, fruity smell.
I like fruity tea with peach and berry.
The fruity candy tasted like strawberries.

easy.def: Upset because you cannot do something.
examples: I was frustrated.
She was frustrated with the puzzle.
He felt frustrated.

more.def: Feeling annoyed or upset because something is not going the way you want.
examples: I was frustrated when the game would not work.
She was frustrated with the hard puzzle.
He felt frustrated at the long wait.

easy.def: Making you feel upset because things go wrong.
examples: The game was frustrating.
It is frustrating when it breaks.
A frustrating puzzle.

more.def: Making you feel annoyed or upset because you cannot do or get what you want.
examples: The puzzle was so frustrating that I almost gave up.
It is frustrating when the video keeps stopping.
The slow computer made the homework frustrating.

easy.def: The feeling you get when you cannot do what you want.
examples: She cried with frustration.
He felt frustration.
Frustration filled the room.

more.def: The upset feeling you have when something stops you from doing what you want.
examples: She cried with frustration when the puzzle would not fit.
He felt frustration as the knot would not come loose.
Her frustration grew as the line did not move.

easy.def: To cook food in hot oil.
examples: Mom will fry an egg.
We fried the fish.
Fry the potatoes.

more.def: To cook food in a pan with hot oil or butter.
examples: Dad fried eggs for breakfast.
Fry the onions until they are soft.
We fried the potatoes in a pan.

easy.def: A pot or machine for frying food.
examples: The fryer is hot.
Dad used the fryer.
The fryer is full of oil.

more.def: A deep pot or machine used for frying food.
examples: The cook put the chips in the fryer.
An air fryer cooks food with hot air.
The fryer is hot, so stay back.
